en.description:
A standalone Dou Dizhu game for Apple Watch — no iPhone required.
Start a match anytime, anywhere, directly on your wrist.

Features
Optimized for the Digital Crown — rotate to scroll through your hand smoothly and play cards with ease.

Designed with dedicated haptic feedback for Apple Watch. Every action provides clear tactile response, delivering a satisfying playing experience.

Built for standalone Watch gameplay — dealing, bidding for landlord, playing cards, and settlement are all completed on your wrist. Perfect for commuting, waiting in line, or short breaks.

Authentic rules simulation, casual and fun to play.

How to Play
Three-player match using 54 cards. Each player receives 17 cards with 3 cards as the bottom cards. Players take turns bidding for landlord. The winner becomes the landlord, takes the 3 bottom cards (20 total), and plays first.

On your turn, you can play a higher combination than the previous player or choose “Pass.” If two players pass consecutively, the table resets and the last player who played starts the next round. The side that plays all cards first wins.

Supports common combinations including singles, pairs, triples with attachments, straights, consecutive pairs, airplanes, bombs, and joker bombs — consistent with classic Dou Dizhu rules.
en.subtitle: Standalone Watch Card Game

zh.trackName: 春节斗地主 For Watch —离线棋牌无需联网随时开局！
zh.description:
Watch 独立斗地主应用，无需 iPhone 在身边，在手表上随时随地即可开局。

游戏特色：
1、专为 Watch 表冠优化，旋转表冠滚动手牌，操作更顺手。
2、专为手表打造的触感反馈，每一次操作都有清晰触觉回应，让对局更有“手感”。
3、为 Watch 独立运行而设计，发牌、抢地主、出牌、结算，全在腕上完成，通勤、排队、休息时随时来一局。
4、真实模拟规则，休闲好玩。

规则说明：
1、三人对局，54 张牌每人 17 张、底牌 3 张；轮流抢地主，先抢者成为地主并拿走底牌（共 20 张），随后地主先出牌。
2、轮到你时可出牌压过上家，或选择“不要”；两家连续不要后桌面清空，由最后出牌者继续出牌，先出完手牌的一方获胜。
3、支持单张、对子、三带、顺子、连对、飞机、炸弹、王炸等常见牌型，规则与经典斗地主一致。
